findings.text: `eval "printf -v test_description '%s' \"$2\""` runs the description as shell code. A description such as `$(rm -rf x)` or one containing a `"` runs the command, or breaks the quoting and gives a syntax error, when the test is registered.

`[[ ${BATS_TEST_NAME-} == $* ]]` leaves `$*` unquoted, so it is treated as a glob pattern. A test named `test_a*`, or one with `?` or `[` in its name, can match a different selected test and set the wrong BATS_TEST_COMMAND and tags. A test name containing spaces also splits oddly.
